name: qlipzync
description: QuickClick SaaS Platform with Extended 7-Stage Pipeline & Zero-Storage Processing

scripts.build: vite build && esbuild server/services/gemini.ts --outfile=server/services/gemini.js --format=esm --platform=node --bundle --packages=external && esbuild server/middleware/authMiddleware.ts --outfile=server/middleware/authMiddleware.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server/schemas/quickClick.schema.ts --outfile=server/schemas/quickClick.schema.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server/services/kmsService.ts --outfile=server/services/kmsService.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server/routes/platform.routes.ts --outfile=server/routes/platform.routes.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server/routes/subscription.routes.ts --outfile=server/routes/subscription.routes.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server/routes/apiKeys.routes.ts --outfile=server/routes/apiKeys.routes.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server/routes/stripe.ts --outfile=server/routes/stripe.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server/routes/topupRoute.ts --outfile=server/routes/topupRoute.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external && esbuild server.ts --outfile=dist/server.js --format=esm --platform=node --bundle --packages=external --target=node22
scripts.test: NODE_ENV=test node --import tsx --test tests/server.test.ts tests/production-readiness.test.mjs tests/stripe-production-safety.test.mjs
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:rules
